# Your MRR, churn and retention, from a read-only Stripe key you control

> See MRR, ARR, net revenue retention, logo churn and quick ratio from your Stripe subscriptions without paying a metrics service a share of your revenue. Paste a subscription export to try it in the browser, then run the open-source read-only server in your own account. Free, MIT.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
